mathematics.assertion_tested: For the exact N64 tau=.5 final t=8 parcel K sample, sort K ascending by equal parcel mass, solve a fixed-mass hydrostatic sphere, test whether its energy is <= the measured cold initial discrete energy, and only then seek alpha>=1 matching that energy. After a positive construction, keep the identical K(m) and alpha fixed and load Plummer baryons Mb=.3M,b=.1R_endpoint; compare 5% and 50% mass radii with a specified circular-shell contraction model. Quantify discrete versus clipped-linear proxy entropy integrals sigma=(K/Kstar)^(1/3).
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE754 float64; scipy DOP853 hydrostatics, brentq scalar shooting; positive K samples; rho_q=G=Kstar=1
mathematics.conventions: K(m) piecewise linear between equal-mass parcel centers, clipped at endpoints; r is independent coordinate; pressure-free surface at occupied rho=rho_q; Eint=int K W dm, Egrav=-int Gm/r dm; no baryons in primary construction
inputs: total_mass and initial.total from that same file
non_claims: No implemented convection or mixing law
Initial target energy has finite-N gravity/kinetic discretization error
Interpolation preserves sampled parcel entropies, not their exact piecewise-constant continuum histogram
Prescribed smooth spherical loading is not a disc or baryonic assembly evolution
